summary.text: Lydia Christensen is the Libertarian Party nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan. Ballotpedia lists her profession as CEO, and she describes herself as a computer scientist who founded her own company. According to her survey, her campaign emphasizes constitutional and digital rights, renewable energy and a Medicaid-for-all proposal.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Appleton West High School (Wisconsin) and attended the University of Wisconsin, Oshkosh and Fox Valley Technical College.
Describes herself as trained as a computer scientist who started her own company, IronFortress LLC; Ballotpedia lists her profession as CEO.
Advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on June 28, 2026.
Describes herself in her survey as a transgender candidate who enjoys music and natural environments.
